sources.entry: Codex CLI - OpenAI's open-source terminal AI agent that runs locally with any model. #free #opensource

summary.one_liner: Codex CLI is OpenAI's open-source coding agent that runs locally in your terminal.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Codex CLI as a coding agent from OpenAI that runs on your own computer. It can be installed through a shell install script (macOS, Linux, Windows), npm (@openai/codex), Homebrew (cask), or by downloading a prebuilt binary from GitHub Releases. Running `codex` starts it, and you can sign in with a ChatGPT plan (Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise) or use an API key. The README points to other Codex surfaces for IDE use (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf), a desktop app, and a cloud agent at chatgpt.com/codex. The installer can fetch from a default source and fall back to GitHub Releases, and an environment variable can force GitHub Releases.
use_cases: run a coding agent in the terminal
AI-assisted coding on a local machine
install an AI coding CLI via npm or Homebrew
sign in to Codex with a ChatGPT plan
use an OpenAI coding agent with an API key

powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm | iex"  (Windows; URL missing from README text)
codex  (then select Sign in with ChatGPT or use an API key)
